statements.status_notes: GHSA-259r-337f-4rfw is scoped to the github.com/klauspost/compress/s2 encoder and requires a caller-supplied dictionary. The Snyk CLI links only the zstd subpackage of klauspost/compress; the s2 encoder is not present in the shipped artifacts.

GHSA-259r-337f-4rfw is scoped to the github.com/klauspost/compress/s2 encoder and requires a caller-supplied dictionary. The Snyk CLI links only the zstd subpackage of klauspost/compress; the s2 encoder is not present in the shipped artifacts.

temporalio-admin-tools 1.28.x and 1.29.x embed klauspost/compress via published dhi/temporalio-server artifacts. debian-13 runtime packages are HSP-based, but these Go binaries still come from the server OCI artifact digests. The temporalio-server definition already bumps compress to 1.18.7; clearing this finding requires republished server images and a digest track update. From 1.30 onward admin-tools builds these binaries from source with golang-1.26 HSP packages and compress 1.18.7.
